size_policy.download_bytes: Resolve from the selected quantized artifact manifest immediately before consent; never present a guessed size as exact.
size_policy.installed_bytes: Estimate from the selected artifact and runtime; show separately from download bytes.
size_policy.ram: Show device-measured available memory plus a conservative model/runtime estimate; label estimates as advisory and do not guarantee fit.

models.purpose: Very small general text model for simple instructions, classification, short answers and lightweight task routing.
limitations: Not intended for complex reasoning, long documents or high-reliability coding.
models.license: Verify the exact upstream model licence and terms before distribution.

models.purpose: Compact text assistant for rewriting, short summaries, simple questions and classification.
limitations: Smaller model; verify factual answers and avoid relying on it for complex multi-step reasoning.
models.license: Verify the exact upstream model licence and terms before distribution.

models.purpose: Lightweight offline text assistance, short conversations and simple summaries.
limitations: Not a substitute for larger models on complex reasoning or coding; Meta licence and acceptable-use terms apply.
models.license: Meta Llama Community Licence; verify current version and obligations.

models.purpose: Small multilingual assistant for everyday questions, summaries and basic structured tool selection.
limitations: Tool calls must be validated by trusted application code; capability varies by runtime/template.
models.license: Verify the exact upstream model licence and terms before distribution.

models.purpose: Compact general-purpose text assistance and short summaries.
limitations: Check model-specific modality support; Gemma terms apply and must be shown before installation.
models.license: Gemma Terms of Use; verify current terms and redistribution conditions.

models.purpose: More capable everyday conversations, summaries and moderate text reasoning.
limitations: Not guaranteed to be reliable for specialist, high-stakes or advanced coding tasks; Meta licence applies.
models.license: Meta Llama Community Licence; verify current version and obligations.

models.purpose: Higher-capability local assistant for stronger reasoning, multilingual work and coding assistance.
limitations: Higher resource demand; verify context, tool-call template and hardware fit for the exact build.
models.license: Verify the exact upstream model licence and terms before distribution.

models.purpose: Compact advanced assistant candidate for structured reasoning, coding and problem-solving.
limitations: Validate quantized variant, context window and runtime compatibility before recommending.
models.license: Verify the exact upstream model licence and terms before distribution.

models.purpose: More capable local assistant for longer conversations, multilingual work, reasoning and coding assistance on higher-memory computers.
limitations: Requires substantially more working memory than small models; verify context, quantisation, hardware fit and runtime support before installation.
models.license: Apache License 2.0; verify the exact artifact and accompanying terms before distribution.

limitations: Not a chat model; transcription accuracy varies by language, noise and recording quality.

specialist_tools.purpose: Speech-to-text with a larger model than Tiny.
limitations: Not a chat model; higher compute and memory demand than Tiny.

specialist_tools.purpose: Creates text embeddings for semantic search and document similarity.
limitations: Not a chat model; primarily English-oriented.

specialist_tools.purpose: Creates text embeddings for retrieval and semantic document search.
Extracts printed text from supported image and scanned-document formats.
limitations: OCR engine, not a generative model; accuracy depends on scan quality and language packs.

runtime.desktop: Ollama is the recommended supported desktop runtime where installed and validated; it is optional and is not bundled with UJANI.
runtime.mobile: Do not recommend Ollama; mobile runtime/model support must be separately validated.

default_recommendation.installation_policy: No model is preselected for automatic download. The default setup keeps model installation optional and continues to provide non-model OS-powered features.

public_profiles.reason: Preserve memory for the operating system and UJANI.

default_recommendation.enterprise_policy: No fleet-wide model is installed by default. The administrator chooses an approved fleet profile; per-device recommendation uses the same conservative hardware bands, tenant allowlist, available memory, storage, runtime compatibility and device-owner consent. Unknown or stale evidence means no model recommendation.
safeguards: RAM thresholds are advisory admission guards, not guarantees.
Recheck available memory and free storage immediately before download and inference.
Keep at least 512 MiB additional memory headroom beyond the selected model's estimated working set.
Use one concurrent inference by default on low-memory devices.
Start with the listed short context; increase only after device-specific benchmarks.
Never auto-download, silently switch models, or fall back to cloud.
